description: B123-B138 iOS Sandbox/Native Provider Runtime实现输入

runtimeBinding.iosNative: RuntimeType enum value for iOS native provider - to be added by B123-B138

iosNativeAdapter.mustUsePermission: PermissionBroker for all iOS capability executions
iosNativeAdapter.platformAuthorization: iOS native permission (HealthKit, Calendar, Contacts) handled by Provider

iOSSandboxAdapter.note: iOS Sandbox Runtime Provider - same RuntimeAdapter pattern
iOSSandboxAdapter.mustNotContain: Global iOS runtime state duplicating existing RuntimeSupervisor

iOSHealthKitProvider.mustUse: iOS HealthKit bridge (via existing iOS IPC)
iOSHealthKitProvider.mustHandle: user_action_required if HealthKit authorization not granted

permissionIntegration.platformAuthorization: iOS Info.plist UsageDescriptions + native permission dialogs
permissionIntegration.mustNotBypass: All iOS Provider executions must pass through PermissionBroker

executionChain.correctPath: Tool -> ToolRegistry -> ExecutionPipeline -> PermissionBroker -> RuntimeAdapter(iOS) -> iOSNativeProvider
